slots.title: Big crypto wants the one thing it can’t buy: your vote
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Our loyalty has been to the technology. This election, the trap is to let the biggest intermediaries claim it for themselves, argues Berkeley Law lecturer Hermine Wong.

slots.title: South Korea urges exchanges to boost cold storage after Binance hack
slots.author: Cointelegraph
slots.summary: South Korean crypto exchanges are already required to hold at least 80% of customer crypto in cold wallets, but the regulator is urging more.

slots.title: Ukraine’s new pocket-sized gadget turns Russian drones’ cameras against them
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: A Kyiv startup’s pocket-sized, 10-ounce receiver lets Ukrainian troops watch the video feeds of Russian drones, though Russian moves toward digital video and AI-guided drones that emit no signals could make the victory short-lived.

slots.title: Y Combinator’s Garry Tan uses AI agents so much, he spends up to $200K a year on tokens
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Y Combinator Garry Tan has jokingly admitted that he's suffered from "cyber psychosis” and barely sleeps sometimes because he’s so excited to be working with his AI agents. On a new episode of Walter Isaacson’s podcast, The Builders, Tan put a price tag on his passion.
